ns2:section.sectionText: Moving people, goods, and services from Point A to Point B, is a global challenge. It requires expertise and knowledge form many different engineering fields and areas of study develop solution to a number of products and services that may include autonomous vehicles’ ground, sea, and land travel; navigation technologies; infrastructure; personal devices; and many others. In this course you will explore and develop projects focused on imagining and improving the future of mobility in our society. Class meets beginning September 30.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
